referential.article:
CFM will determine which parts are required to perform the Services and will provide all parts and materials (new, used Serviceable, or Rotable Parts). Title to parts and material furnished by CFM will pass to Customer upon incorporation in the Engine.

Customer shall retain title to removed Parts and such removed Parts shall be held at the DRS for [days] Days for the Customer to review and/or retrieve them. After such period, any Parts not retrieved by Customer become CFM property.

For the avoidance of doubt, if a part or LRU is repaired after cleaning /inspection/ 
test, only repair price will be charged as Supplemental Work to Airline. Any repair included in the 
RPL will be performed and charged in accordance with the applicable RPL

In the event Non-OEM Parts or Non-OEM Repairs are exposed during the shop visit, CFM will replace the corresponding parts, on a Time and Material Basis with OEM hardware. Customer will be notified of the disposition and an alternate solution may be proposed to Customer. LLP hardware operated with influencing Non-OEM Parts or Non-OEM Repairs per Chapter 5 of the appropriate CFM approved shop manual and any relevant Service Bulletin concerning Critical Influencing Parts will be considered influenced by unknown operational conditions and replacement will be made by CFM on a Time and Material Basis. Any resulting adverse effects to Engine TAT at the shop will be mutually agreed, and the original TAT (if any) will be increased by the agreed Days. Non-OEM Parts or Non-OEM Repairs that are not exposed during a shop visit shall remain in an Engine. If, however, these and any other Non-OEM Parts or Non-OEM Repairs, or LLP hardware operated with influencing Non-OEM Parts or Non-OEM Repairs, cause an Unserviceable condition or Engine removal, the costs associated with such events will not be covered by the warranties provided in this Service Agreement.

CFM's obligation to provide such lease engine will terminate when the AOG condition is corrected by the receipt of an Engine by the Customer at its facility, subject to Customer's obligation to return the lease engine set forth below, and

Customer shall pay the hourly restoration charges and the LLP fees per flight cycle payable under the lease in respect of the lease engine until the lease engine is removed from Customer's Aircraft. CFM shall waive the daily engine rental fees payable under the lease in respect of the lease engine for the AOG condition and up to [calendar_days] calendar days after the receipt of the Customer's Engine at its facility. Customer will commence paying any and all daily engine rental fees on the [day] [format] calendar day following receipt of the Customer's Engine at its facility.

ln the event that CFM cannot provide such lease engine in accordance with the above terms CFM will, as liquidated damages, issue a credit to Customer in the amount of {[year]} [amount] [currency] per Day, such amount shall escalate on an annual basis in accordance with the escalation formula set forth in the Widget "Escalation", beginning on the Day after such AOG situation occurs up to the receipt of an Engine at the Customer's facility.

This Services warranty is applicable only if the Engine/Parts, following Redelivery,

(a) has been transported, stored, installed, operated, handled, maintained, repaired in accordance with the then-current CFM recommendations as stated in AMM or CFM manuals, Airworthiness Directives, Service Bulletins, and other relevant written instructions

(b) has not been altered, modified or repaired by anyone other than the CFM Designated Repair Station; and
